project: Test Design Skill - Commercial Voice Agent

direction.name: Bioluminescent Pulse & Deep Surface
direction.story: An immersive enterprise interface pairing a vibrant celestial acoustic sphere with disciplined, dark-sapphire glass cards. It makes voice intelligence tactile and alive while maintaining high commercial clarity.

refs.contributes: Radiant multi-ring acoustic sphere, dark cosmos depth, pulsing light states
Modular card hierarchy, crisp dark UI surface cards, enterprise metric chips

display.why: Precise, modern geometric sans that projects authority without stiffness

body.why: Ultra-clean readability on high-contrast dark surfaces

mono.why: Technical clarity for latency, timestamps, and audio sample rates

shape.radius: 16px on content cards, full pills on status chips and interactive controls
shape.depth: Subtle 1px border glows (#182C4A) with deep blue radial underglows behind key elements
shape.texture: Atmospheric soft radial glow behind the primary sphere; no distracting background patterns
shape.imagery: Reactive acoustic light waveforms, live circular audio visualization, enterprise metric badges
